briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 and xAI Colossus-3 accelerate AGI timelines as compute arms race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs push multi-trillion parameter models while regulatory scrutiny mounts. AI investment surges past $11B this quarter amid record model releases. Geopolitical tensions over chip exports continue to shape the landscape.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys Orion-2 with advanced reasoning; xAI launches Colossus-3. Anthropic and Google DeepMind release iterative updates focusing on agentic capabilities. Meta open-sources new Llama variant.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp accelerates with TSMC 2nm production. Microsoft and Google announce new hyperscale AI data centers in Europe and Asia. Energy constraints emerge as key bottleneck.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will first-mover advantage in agentic AI systems create an unbridgeable lead by 2028 or enable rapid catch-up by open-source coalitions?
